description: Dual authorization controls for critical operations are not implemented. This signal indicates that sensitive actions can be performed by a single individual without independent verification.
applicability: Applicable to high-impact operations in Level 3 environments. Includes privileged access actions, system configuration changes, and critical data operations requiring two-person integrity.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through dual authorization policy review, critical operation workflow verification, and two-person control assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
